I am a 33 year old Indian male from Mumbai, staying in workig in Abu Dhabi. I have pproximately 20-22 years of Qada namaz. I came across a site called www.islamicacademy.com giving the following easy way of praying For the people who have many years of missed Salahs. There is a way to pray them quickly. Following instructions have four exeptions and has all Fards and Wajibs for a complete Salat. Please pray your Qaza as soon as possible. Even of you could pray one days Qaza Salahs every day which are only 20 rakahs (3 wajib witr), please do it. It only takes few mins to perform 20 rakahs according to the following instructions. 1) In Ruku and Sajdah instead of reciting "Subhaana Rabbiyal Azeem" and "Subhaana Rabbiyal A'la" three times, say it only once. But make sure do not leave Ruku poster untill the Meem (M) of Azeem has been said properly. Similarly do not leave the posture of Sajdah until Ala has been said completely. Just make sure to say these Tasbeehaat properly and do not rush. 2) In third and four Rakah of Fard Salah instead of reciting the whole Soorah Fatiha say, "Subhan Allah" three times and go to Ruku, . Make sure "Subhan Allah" has been recited three times properly, do not rush. This exeption is only for Fard. In third rakah of Witr it's a must to recite full Soorah Fatiha followed by at least three ayahs of Quran or a soorah (as we usually do in first and second rakah). 3) In last Qaidah (when we sit for Attahyyat) before Salam, after Attahyyat instead of full Durood and Dua just say, "Allah Humma Salle Ala Sayedena Mohammad Wa Aalihi", then finish the Salat with Salam. Dua is not a must here. 4) In Witr, instead of full Dua-e-Qunoot just say "Rabbigh Fir Lee" one or three times. (Fatawa Rizvia, Part 3, Page 622) Can you please advise if the above method can be followed sagely 2924 views Q. I m the follower of Hanafi Madhab. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 154467 Country: United States of America Title: Salat Al-Kusoof (Prayer of the Solar Eclipse) Question: According to the opinion of Imam Abu Hanifah Salat Al-Kusoof is read quietly in congregation. While Imam Abu Yusuf and Imam Muhammad hold the view that Salat Al-Kusoof is read out loud in congregation. As I am a follower of the Hanafi school of thought my question is which opinion should i follow? And why? Please provide dalail (proofs) and references. Answer ID: 154467 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1498/1496/L=1/1439) According to Fatawa Hindia, the opinion of Imam Abu Hanifah (may Allah have mercy upon him) will be preferred, thus you should follow him. ولا يجهر بالقراءة فى صلاة الجماعة فى صلاة كسوف الشمس فى قول أبى حنيفة رحمه الله كذا في المحيط والصحيح قوله . (الهندية: 1/152) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
